identity_verification: A LinkedIn post by Philip Vyt names Beth Luyten with Maja Beilmann-Schramm and Lorna Fergusson as the three people who delivered a hands-on worksession on creating a focused Field Medical plan at NEXT Medical. The NEXT Medical agenda lists exactly those three speakers for 'Build Workshop: From Medical Plan to Field Medical Strategy' (Day 1, 02:30 PM, Main Stage), with Beth Luyten as Medical Doctor & Medical Sr. Manager at Amgen. This source only confirms their part in that workshop; it gives no career history.

sources.title: LinkedIn post by Philip Vyt about the NEXT Medical field medical plan worksession (screenshot supplied by the project owner, no link kept)
sources.text:
Philip Vyt (3rd+), 'Innovating Omnichannel Engagement in Life Sciences and Pharma...', posted 8 months before the screenshot was taken on 2026-10-11:

"Maja Beilmann-Schramm, PhD Lorna Fergusson and Beth Luyten delivered a very strong hands-on worksession on creating a focused Field Medical plan. If you succeed in keeping the audience involved just after lunch, you clearly delivered. Great work!"

The post photo shows the three on the NEXT Medical stage in front of a slide reading 'Can AI help us with FM planning'. The post had 29 reactions, 1 comment and 1 repost.
